entry.title: Commission to investigate how Booking.com combats scams and fraud under the Digital Services Act
entry.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 21 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission has opened formal proceedings to assess whether Booking.com may have breached the Digital Services Act (DSA) by not having diligently assessed or effectively mitigated risks related to fraudulent listings and phishing scams.
